items.title: 25.4 Dawa sazi mein artificial intelligence (AI) ka istemal (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the use of AI in drug design (PDF 142).

blocks.text: Pichhli chand dahaiyon mein bohat kam naye antibiotics bane hain, aur jo bane woh maujooda se thore hi mukhtalif hain. Nayi dawaiyan banane ke maujooda tareeqe bohat mehnge aur waqt talab hain aur aam taur par kimiyai asar ka tang daira dekhte hain. Saath hi zyada se zyada infections maujooda antibiotics ke khilaf mazahmat karte hain.

blocks.alt: Halicin: paanch kone wale 1,3,4-thiadiazole ring par H2N (oopar ring ka S, neeche N-N), jo darmiyani S ke zariye paanch kone wale thiazole ring (oopar ring ka S, neeche baen N) se jura hai jis par NO2 hai.
blocks.caption: Halicin ki banawat (structure) (kitab ke PDF safha 142 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ke halicin khaake mein dono paanch kone wale rings ki oopar wali chotti par koi atom nahi likha, jis se lagta hai wahan carbon hai. Asal mein halicin ke dono rings mein wahan sulphur (S) hai: baen taraf 1,3,4-thiadiazole ring aur daen taraf thiazole ring. Is liye hamare khaake mein dono rings mein S likha gaya hai; beech wala S dono rings ko jorta hai.

Hal dhoondne ke liye MIT (Massachusetts Institute of Technology) ke mohaqqiqeen ne machine-learning model banaya jo un kimiyai khasiyaton ko dhoonde jo molecules ko E. coli bacteria marne mein mo'assar banati hain. Unhon ne ise taqreeban 2500 molecules par train kiya, jin mein mukhtalif banawat aur wasee asraat wale 800 qudrati products bhi the. Compounds ke bare majmue par lagane se model ne aik molecule chuna jis ke bacteria maar hone ki tawaqqo thi lekin jis ki banawat maujooda antibiotics se mukhtalif thi. Aik aur model ne andaza lagaya ke yeh insani cells ke liye ghaliban kam zehreela hoga. Is molecule ka naam halicin rakha gaya aur mareezon se liye gaye bacteria par aazmaya gaya: is ne duniya ke bohat se mushkil tareen bimari phailane wale bacteria maar diye jo ilaaj ke khilaf mazahmat kar chuke the.

Halicin pehchanne ke baad mohaqqiqeen ne apne model se database ke 10 crore se zyada molecules sirf teen din mein jaanche. Is ne maujooda antibiotics se mukhtalif banawat wale 23 mazeed molecules chune; in mein se aath ne bacteria ke khilaf asar dikhaya aur do khaas taur par taqatwar the. Yeh kaam dawa ke taur par use ho sakne wale organic molecules daryaft karne ka naya raasta dikhata hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Kitab batati hai ke vitamin B12 ki mukammal synthesis R. B. Woodward aur A. Eschenmoser ne 1972 mein 10 saal se zyada ke ishtirak ke baad ki; is mein 100 se zyada qadam, 91 post-doctoral mohaqqiqeen aur 12 PhD talib-e-ilm shamil the.

blocks.prompt: AI model ne kya kiya jo lab ki aazmaish se bohat aahista hota?
blocks.explanation: Is ne bohat zyada molecules ke bacteria maar asar (aur mumkina zehreele pan) ka andaza lagaya, teen din mein 10 crore se zyada jaanche aur lab ki aazmaish ke liye halicin jaise chand umeedwar chune.

items: Naye antibiotics kam; mazahmat barh rahi.
MIT ke machine-learning model ne halicin dhoonda jo mazahmati bacteria maarta.
3 din mein 10 crore se zyada molecules ki jaanch se 23 umeedwar, 8 fa'aal.
